summary: Join our Dashboard Development for M&E Reporting Training Course. Master the art of building dashboards that streamline reporting and improve decision-making.
lede: Dashboard development for M&E reporting combines data preparation with visual design to make performance information easier to explore. Designed for M&E professionals, analysts, project managers and program teams, the course covers KPI selection, visualisation, interactive filters, stakeholder-focused data storytelling, and accuracy, privacy and confidentiality in reporting.
audience: M&E professionals in NGOs, public, and private
modules: Introduction to Dashboard Development for M&E
Tools and Software for Dashboard Development
Data Governance and Ethics in M&E Reporting
